name: Quetiapine
effects: Transient D2 blockade plus strong H1/5HT2A antagonism
Strong sedation at low doses (H1 dominant) — widely misused for insomnia
Moderate metabolic effects: weight gain, dyslipidemia, glucose elevation
Very low EPS risk due to rapid D2 dissociation
Active metabolite norquetiapine has norepinephrine reuptake inhibition

halfLifeEvidence.quote: Elimination of quetiapine is mainly via hepatic metabolism with a mean terminal half-life of about 6 hours within the proposed clinical dose range.
halfLifeEvidence.identity: active ingredient names 'quetiapine' as whole words
halfLifeEvidence.note: The extended-release (SEROQUEL XR) label states approximately 7 hours; the immediate-release figure is the one this row carries.
